name: ADU-S100 (MIW815)
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "The first STING agonist in the clinic. Injected directly into tumours, it produced almost no responses, alone or with checkpoint blockade."
fields.after: "ADU-S100 was the first STING agonist in the clinic. Injected directly into tumours, it produced almost no responses, alone or with checkpoint blockade."
